<DOCSTRING>
Bundles a sequence of transformations from the current word to the end word.

Args:
    current_word (str): The current word in the transformation sequence.
    path (list[str]): The list of transformations from begin_word to current_word.
    end_word (str): The target word for transformation.
    word_set (set[str]): The set of valid words for transformation.

Returns:
    list[str]: The list of transformations from begin_word to end_word. Returns an empty list if there is no valid transformation from current_word to end_word.
</DOCSTRING>
